episode.descriptionJp: いつもスクールアイドルクラブを支えてくれている皆に感謝を伝える、そのためのライブが決定したものの、かっこつけた花帆は難題を抱え込み!?
episode.descriptionEn: A live show has been decided so they can express their gratitude to everyone who has always supported the School Idol Club, but Kaho, trying to act cool, takes on a difficult problem!?

Let's see...
